## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Explain material baseline or
validation changes and their impact on consumers.

## Changelog

Propose a concise changelog summary with supporting references, or briefly
explain why this change is not notable. Keep issue references descriptive;
follow the [issue-closure guidance](https://github.com/jamesreimer/agent-workflows/blob/main/roles/publication.md#github-issue-closure).

## Validation

Record checks performed and the behavior they establish. Include limitations
or unresolved findings and their disposition.
